title: AE pages
author: Iced-Cream (for hugz202's AE-analog-rytm-mods)
description: What the AE mods' extra parameter pages share on the Analog Rytm MKII: one place in each of page_info (its eight callers), page_get_value, param_apply_delta and param_value_text, handed on to every page in its table (ae_pages). Each page mod adds a descriptor: its page id, its page entry, and get, delta and text functions for its knobs. On the MK1 these hooks are shared through the build's detour chains; on the MKII rytm2_mods holds the free instructions at the start of those routines, so this takes the next one in each. On its own it changes nothing the unit does.
